text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Where is this? Why is Rice in a 
place like this?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother? Anyone... Is anyone 
there...?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister? Is someone... Is anyone 
there...?
Found you, Black Assassin.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyau!? Wh-Who is it...!?

text_block_list.name: Vampire
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, I am the Lord of Darkness come to 
claim you —a Vampire.

text_block_list.name: Vampire
text_block_list.text: Now, come. Become prey for my fangs...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: E-Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...or so I dreamed...

During training time, I asked a 
downhearted Rice Shower what was wrong, 
and she told me she had had a scary dream.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, even though I know I really 
need to rest...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, it's all my fault...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I ended up recommending all sorts of 
vampire-related books to Rice-san...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No, Rob Roy-san didn't do anything wrong! 
Rice asked about it... because it was 
Halloween and I got curious...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It was scary, but a dream is just a dream. 
Once I wake up, I'll be fine... so it's 
okay.

"Even so, if they don't get proper rest, 
it could hinder their training. I can't 
just leave things like this—"
choice_data_list: How about casting a good luck charm?
We're gonna take down that vampire!

text_block_list.text:
"Even so, if they don't get proper rest, 
it could hinder their training. I can't 
just leave things like this—"
choice_data_list: How about casting a good luck charm?
We're gonna take down that vampire!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A good luck, charm?

As Rice Shower looked on with a puzzled 
expression, I showed her the spare 
horseshoe I had brought along.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Is something wrong with your 
horseshoes...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see! Horseshoes are said to ward off 
evil spirits, after all!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
They say the fairies who bring nightmares 
hate iron... Let's go decorate our dorm 
room door right away!
choice_data_list:
If you need more horseshoes, I can get 
them for you.

If you need more horseshoes, I can get 
them for you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, more...!? Wh-Where should I display 
them...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'll help too. Shall we decorate the 
entrance to the dorm as well?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I heard sage leaves 
are also used as a charm to ward off 
nightmares. Would you like to go pick some 
together?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy-san, Big Brother too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy-san, Big Sister too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. With both of you by my side, 
I'm starting to feel like everything will 
be all right...!

With her smile restored, Rice Shower 
cheerfully reported the next morning that 
she had slept wonderfully...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-Whaat!? What do you mean, 'defeat'...!?

Vampires are formidable monsters, but told 
her that Umamusume should be able to 
defeat them if they train hard enough...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? But if you say so, Onii-sama, 
then maybe it's true...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? But if you say so, Onee-sama, 
then maybe it's true...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fweh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: E-Eeeek!?

Rice Shower flees in the blink of an eye. 
Contrary to her screams, her strides kick 
the turf with immense power...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"You're doing great, Rice-san! If you can 
take this image into your dreams, even 
nightmares won't be scary at all!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...! I see. If that's the case, Rice will 
try her best to picture it...!

And so, the training under the pretext of 
defeating a vampire continued...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Good work out there...! Rice, how did it 
feel...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... You know, I think I might not 
be as scared anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah... But I noticed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"If vampires were like you, Big Brother, I 
wouldn't want to defeat them... I'd want 
to be friends."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If vampires were like Big Sister, instead 
of fighting them... I'd want to be 
friends.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, so, you know... The next time we meet 
in a dream, I'll do my best so we can 
become good friends...!

Rice Shower was gentle and kind to the 
very core.
